Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
You asked for this meeting, so I'm here. I'm waiting for an answer about the zero.
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
Version history. Show me, with the dates, and turn the screen so I can read it myself.

Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that you send me the version history you raised, with every date shown. I expect all of this in writing by Thursday, November 12.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
